entries.message: Fix - Make Now Playing update faster and prevent false "stopped" readings
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Now Playing reflects a session starting or ending within seconds instead of up to a minute later
Plex sessions update instantly by reusing the existing live connection to Plex, adding no extra load
Opening the dashboard or returning to a background tab refreshes Now Playing immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check
Fixed a bug where a single failed check against Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin could wrongly mark a still-playing session as stopped and record it as partially watched
Fixed a bug where Plex switching video quality mid-playback could trigger the same false "stopped" misdetection
